Four-region scheme (National Development Council): Northern Taiwan = Taipei, New Taipei, Keelung, Taoyuan, Hsinchu, Yilan (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Regions_of_Taiwan)
DESIGN CHOICE: the northern coastline (Taipei, New Taipei, Keelung, Taoyuan, Hsinchu) without Yilan, which faces east
DESIGN CHOICE: Yilan is the only county that is both Northern Taiwan (four-region scheme) and Eastern Taiwan (two-region scheme), https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Regions_of_Taiwan
Two-region scheme: Eastern Taiwan = Yilan, Hualien, Taitung, east of the Central Mountain Range (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Regions_of_Taiwan)
Four-region scheme: Central Taiwan = Miaoli, Taichung, Changhua, Nantou, Yunlin (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Regions_of_Taiwan); our 'west' region holds its coastal counties
Two-region scheme: Western Taiwan = all divisions from Taipei to Pingtung west of the Central Mountain Range (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Regions_of_Taiwan)
Four-region scheme: Southern Taiwan = Chiayi, Tainan, Kaohsiung, Pingtung, Penghu (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Regions_of_Taiwan)
DESIGN CHOICE: the Hengchun Peninsula (Pingtung), the only south-facing coastline
DESIGN CHOICE: the west-facing coast of Southern Taiwan (Chiayi, Tainan, Kaohsiung)
Outlying Islands (Kinmen, Matsu) and Penghu, plus the islets Green Island and Orchid Island (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Regions_of_Taiwan)
